context: A rainy afternoon. Grandpa Goro shows Sho how to fold a paper crane, patient as the small hands struggle.
purpose: grandfather teaching grandchild — patience and small mastery

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: まず、こうやって半分に折ってごらん。
lines.en: First, try folding it in half like this.
lines.style: Slow grandfather demonstration, warm patient cadence, deliberate hands-on instruction floating gently.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Tiny careful six-year-old checking, voice barely above whisper, focused brow audible in the question.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: うん、いいよ。ゆっくりでいい。
lines.en: Yes, that's good. Slow is fine.
lines.style: Reassuring grandfather warmth, no rush in the praise, soft permission to take all the time needed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small six-year-old struggle voice, careful honesty admitting difficulty, no whine just observation softly.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: 一緒にやろう。手を貸して。
lines.en: Let's do it together. Lend me your hand.
lines.style: Grandfather gentle offer, slow deliberate kindness in the proposal, no taking-over just helping alongside.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quiet six-year-old assent, soft small voice accepting the help, comfort threading through the brief sound.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: ほら、ここを押さえて。よし。
lines.style: Steady grandfather guidance, voice low and warm, the 「よし」 landing with shared satisfaction earned.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I did it…! I made a crane!
lines.style: Quiet six-year-old amazement transitioning to bright soft delight, voice lifting on the second exclamation.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.style: Genuine grandfather warmth blooming, slow stretched 「なあ」 holding deep affectionate pride throughout.
